title: Listen and Choose a Response — Train Station

questions.stem: They just announced that our train is delayed an hour.

options.A: Let's grab something to eat while we wait.
options.B: The train station has six platforms.
options.C: I'll announce it at the meeting.
options.D: Great, we'll leave right on time.

questions.explanation: Suggesting how to use the waiting time is a natural reply; the last option contradicts the delay.
questions.speaker: f3

audioSegments.text: They just announced that our train is delayed an hour.
